Daily Devotional

July 4

Happy July 4th!

17 Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning. 18 Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures. (James 1:17-18 KJV)

The context of this verse is speaking of God not being the author of our temptations. God only puts good opportunities in our life and not the temptations that we all run into. Problems will come, but not from God. All good and perfect gifts are from God, and all evil and bad tribulations come from the devil (John 10:10). God does not put sickness, problems or anything evil in our lives as many preach, but if it is good it is from God, and if it is bad it is from the devil, or this fallen world.

Notice that there is no variableness in God. He is the same yesterday, today and forever, so we do not have to wonder how God will act, as He never changes. God is always good, as God is love (1 John 4:8). We are not born again by our own will, but God of His own will, begat us through the truth of His Word (1 Peter 1:23). We, the body of Christ, are the firstfruits of all His creatures, not by our holiness, but by the mercies of God the Father. Praise God for loving us so much that He came and died for us.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
